questions.question:
If ‘A’ means ‘+’, ‘B’ means ‘–’, ‘C’ means ‘×’, and ‘D’ means ‘÷’, what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

44 A 36 B 60 D 30 C 5 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 Alphabets
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Symbols
 +
 -
 × 
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression : 44 A 36 B 60 D 30 C 5 = ?

After replacing the given symbols in place of alphabets the expression is as follows : 44 + 36 - 60 ÷ 30 × 5 = ?

= 44 + 36 - __**60 ÷ 30**__ × 5 

= 44 + 36 -__** 2 × 5**__

= __**44 + 36**__ - 10

= __**80 - 10**__

**= 70**

∴ Here, the correct answer is **"70".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are B.

II. No X is W.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some B are W.

II. Some W are X.

III. All X are B.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/333e2ad0ca69ba0dbe324a16253e8d09bd24d60152d79981ac74036fe03a9628.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some B are W → True (As All W are B so, Some B are W is true)

II. Some W are X → False (As No X is W so, Some W are X is definitely false)

III. All X are B → False (As All W are B and No X is W so, All X are B is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All T are F.

II. Some P are T.

**Conclusions:**

I. No F is P.

II. Some F are P is a possibility.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7acac9105d5f6f61d371d83e8c0ce9d0629b45e334f354e92e1364f39f57a3b5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No F is P → False (As All T are F and Some P are T so, No F is P is false)

II. Some F are P is a possibility. → False (When given conclusion is true then the possibility given is not followed. So, the possibility is not followed)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**

questions.question:
Which two number should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 6 – 5 = 100
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 9 and 6

Given equation : 72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 6 – 5 = 100

After interchanging the symbols in the given equation the equation formed is as follows : 72 ÷ 6 × 8 + 9 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**72 ÷ 6**__ × 8 + 9 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**12**____** × 8**__ + 9 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**96**____** + 9**__ – 5 = 100

⇒ __**105 **____**– 5**__ = 100

⇒ **100**** = 100**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : 9 and 8

Given equation : 72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 6 – 5 = 100

After interchanging the symbols in the given equation the equation formed is as follows : 72 ÷ 8 × 9 + 6 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**72 ÷ 8**__ × 9 + 6 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**9**____** × 9**__ + 6 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**81**____** + 6**__ – 5 = 100

⇒ __**87**____** – 5**__ = 100

⇒ 82 ≠ 100

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 6 and 8

Given equation : 72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 6 – 5 = 100

After interchanging the symbols in the given equation the equation formed is as follows : 72 ÷ 9 × 6 + 8 – 5 = 100

⇒ __**72 ÷ 9**__ × 6 + 8 – 5 = 100

​⇒ __**8 × 6**__ + 8 – 5 = 100

​⇒ __**48 + 8**__ – 5 = 100

​⇒ __**56 – 5**__ = 100

​⇒ 51 ≠ 100

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 9 and 5

Given equation : 72 ÷ 9 × 8 + 6 – 5 = 100

After interchanging the symbols in the given equation the equation formed is as follows : 72 ÷ 5 × 8 + 6 – 9 = 100

⇒ __**72 ÷ 5**__ × 8 + 6 – 9 = 100

⇒ __**14.4 × 8**__ + 6 – 9 = 100

⇒ __**115.2 + 6**__ – 9 = 100

⇒ __**121.2 – 9**__ = 100

⇒ 112.2 ≠ 100

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"9 and 6".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given sets.

(4, 9, 16)

(81, 100, 121)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Second number = (First number¹/² + 1)²

Third number = (Second number¹/² + 2)²

 
• (4, 9, 16) → (4, (4¹/² + 1)², (41/2 + 2)²) → (4, 3², 4²) → (2², 3², 4²)
 
• (81, 100, 121) → (81, (81¹/² + 1)², (811/2 + 1)²) → (81, 10², 11²) → (9², 10², 11²)
 
• **(36, 49, 64) → (36, (36¹/² + 1)², (36¹/² + 2)²) → (36, 7², 8²) → (6², 7², 8²)**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(36, 49, 64)".**
